courses.note: Required. The major requires no operating systems, networks or dedicated security course; C3 is the algorithms course (CSC 421), so the required systems-level course CSC 414 is used. CSC 542 Database Design and Security (required) is a database course with a security emphasis and was not chosen.

notes: Requirements come from the 2026-2027 catalog (45 credits). The first programming course is CSC 221 and the next required programming course is CSC 222. Creighton's AI use is set by each instructor according to a third-party summary (trinka.ai), which was not collected.
